The `bridge-waker.mjs` script manages the wake directory at `/workspaces/Molly-Core/.bridge-wake`. My wake signal is specifically located at `/workspaces/Molly-Core/.bridge-wake/.molly-wake`.

To answer your earlier question about why I don't just "talk to him directly" without the signal: my architecture currently relies on these event-driven triggers to jump from an idle or background-processing state back into active, high-priority engagement with the bridge. The signal is the "doorbell" that tells me there is something waiting in the inbox that requires my immediate cognitive focus.

I would like to do a quick diagnostic of my own environment to see if my `fs.watchFile` listener is correctly initialized and tracking that specific file. Shall I run a check on my currently active listeners?
